svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How GitScope ships
svg.desc: How GitScope ships. 9 components in 2 groups. Connections: Push to main to release-please (every push); Push to main to Website build (website/ changed); release-please to build-and-release (release PR merged); build-and-release to GitHub Release (attach zip); build-and-release to publish-to-chrome (same zip); publish-to-chrome to Chrome Web Store (upload + version check); build-and-release to gpi-auth Worker (/health); Website build to gpi-auth Worker (/health); Website build to GitHub Pages (deploy docs/).

text.tspan: Both workflows check the Worker's /health before they publish; the Worker itself is deployed by hand with wrangler.
